items.text: The NIFTY 500 was flat on 11 Nov. Capital Goods was the strongest sector (+1.6%) and Media Entertainment & Publication the weakest (+0.3%).
Foreign investors bought a net ₹13,113 Cr of Indian shares in 16-31 Oct 2026, after selling ₹47,956 Cr in 1-15 Oct 2026. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 41 niches.
